_doc: The promenade units' rooms (blender/city/buildings/promenade_unit.py, one dressing per trade). Their counters use the usual shops and service acts (counters.json: the shops' roles are the town life's unit staff, city_plan.UNIT_STAFF_BY_NAME); only the photo studio's portrait is new. Rules name the things as promenade_unit/<thing id> (every unit of a trade has the same ids).
